title.zh: 卷三十四 志第十 曆四
title.raw: 卷三十四 志第十 曆四 Volume 34 Treatises 10: Calendar 4

sentences.zh: 志第十 歷四

translations.literal: Treatise 10, Calendar 4.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Ten: Calendrics, Part Four.

sentences.zh: 大統曆法二立成

translations.literal: Grand Concordance Calendar Method Two: Ready Reckoners.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Grand Concordance Calendar Method, Part Two: Ready Reckoners.

sentences.zh: 立成者，以日月五星盈縮遲疾之數，預爲排定，以便推步取用也。

translations.literal: Ready reckoners: using the numbers of expansion-contraction and slow-rapid for sun, moon, and five stars, pre-arranged in tables for convenient use in stepwise computation.
translations.idiomatic: Ready reckoners tabulate the expansion–contraction and slow–rapid values of the sun, moon, and five planets in advance, arranged for ready retrieval in stepwise computation.

sentences.zh: 《元志》、《曆經》步七政盈縮遲疾，皆有二術。

translations.literal: The Yuan History and Calendar Classic, in stepping the seven regulators' expansion-contraction and slow-rapid, each have two procedures.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuan History and the Calendar Classic, the procedures for the seven regulators' expansion–contraction and slow–rapid motion each take two forms.

sentences.zh: 其一術以三差立算者，即 布立成法也。

translations.literal: One procedure establishes calculation by the three differences—this is the arrayed ready-reckoner method.
translations.idiomatic: One establishes the calculation through the three differences—this is the arrayed ready-reckoner method.

sentences.zh: 其又術雲，以其下盈縮分，乘入限分萬約之，以加其下盈縮積者，用立成法也。

translations.literal: The other procedure says: multiply the expansion-contraction portion below by the entry-limit portion, reduce by ten thousand, add to the expansion-contraction accumulation below—the ready-reckoner method is used.
translations.idiomatic: The other reads: multiply the underlying expansion–contraction increment by the degrees entered into the limit, scale by ten thousand, and add it to the underlying expansion–contraction accumulation—this is the ready-reckoner method.

sentences.zh: 而遣立成未載，無從入算。

translations.literal: Yet the transmitted ready reckoners were not recorded—there is no basis for entering the calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the transmitted ready reckoners were never recorded, leaving no basis for the calculation.

sentences.zh: 今依《大統歷通軌》具錄之。

translations.literal: Now according to the Comprehensive Track of the Grand Concordance Calendar, fully recorded.
translations.idiomatic: They are reproduced here in full from the Comprehensive Track of the Grand Concordance Calendar.

sentences.zh: 其目四：曰太陽盈縮，曰晨昏分，曰太陰遲疾，曰五星盈縮。

translations.literal: Its sections are four: called solar expansion-contraction, morning-evening divisions, lunar slow-rapid, five stars' expansion-contraction.
translations.idiomatic: There are four sections: solar expansion–contraction, morning and evening divisions, lunar slow–rapid motion, and planetary expansion–contraction.

sentences.zh: 餘詳《法原》及《推步》卷中。

translations.literal: The remainder is detailed in Origins of Methods and in the Stepwise Computation juan.
translations.idiomatic: Further particulars appear in Origins of the Method and in the Stepwise Computation fascicle.

sentences.zh: 按《元史》，至正十七年《授時曆》成。

translations.literal: Commentary: According to the Yuan History, in the seventeenth year of Zhizheng the Season Granting Calendar was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Note: According to the Yuan History, the Season Granting Calendar was completed in the seventeenth year of Zhizheng.

sentences.zh: 十九年王恂卒，時歷雖頒，然立成之數尚皆有定藁。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Wang Xun died; though the calendar had been promulgated, the ready-reckoner numbers still all had fixed drafts.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xun died in the nineteenth year. The calendar had been promulgated, but the ready-reckoner constants still existed only as settled drafts.

sentences.zh: 郭守敬比類編次，整齊分秒，裁爲二卷。

translations.literal: Guo Shoujing drew analogies to arrange and compile, aligned fen and miao, trimmed to two juan.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Shoujing drew analogies among the drafts, harmonized the minutes and seconds, and reduced the work to two fascicles.

sentences.zh: 而今欽天監本，載嘉議大夫太史令臣王恂奉敕撰。

translations.literal: Yet the present Imperial Astronomical Bureau edition records: Raised-Proposal Grandee, Director of the Astronomy Bureau, Wang Xun, subject commissioned to compile by imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Astronomical Bureau edition now in use, however, credits Raised-Proposal Grandee and Grand Astrologer Wang Xun as having composed it by imperial commission.

sentences.zh: 意者王先有藁，而郭卒成之歟？

translations.literal: Perhaps Wang had drafts first, and Guo completed them in the end?
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps Wang prepared the drafts and Guo brought them to completion?

sentences.zh: 太陽盈初縮末限立成冬至前後二象限同用

translations.literal: Solar expansion-initial contraction-final limit ready reckoners: two quadrants before and after winter solstice used alike.
translations.idiomatic: Ready reckoners for the solar expansion-initial and contraction-final interval: the two quadrants before and after the winter solstice share the same table.

sentences.zh: 表格略

translations.literal: Table abbreviated.
translations.idiomatic: [Table omitted.]

sentences.zh: 晨分加二百五十分，爲日出分。

translations.literal: Add 250 fen to morning division to obtain sunrise division.
translations.idiomatic: Add 250 parts to the morning division to obtain the sunrise division.

sentences.zh: 日週一萬分，內減晨分爲昏分。

translations.literal: Solar circuit 10,000 fen; subtract morning division within to obtain evening division.
translations.idiomatic: From the solar circuit of 10,000 parts, subtract the morning division to obtain the evening division.

sentences.zh: 昏分減二百五十分，爲日入分，又減五千分，爲半晝分。

translations.literal: Evening division minus 250 fen is sunset division; again minus 5,000 fen is half-daylight division.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract 250 parts from the evening division for sunset, and a further 5,000 parts for half-daylight.

sentences.zh: 故立成只列晨昏分，則出入及半晝分皆具，不必盡列也。

translations.literal: Therefore the ready reckoners list only morning-evening divisions—then sunrise-sunset and half-daylight are all present; there is no need to list them all.
translations.idiomatic: The ready reckoners therefore list only the morning and evening divisions; sunrise, sunset, and half-daylight follow from them without need for separate columns.

sentences.zh: 以下表格略

translations.literal: Below, tables abbreviated.
translations.idiomatic: [Tables below omitted.]
